parts.label: c

parts.reason: Explicit exclusion: 'calculations involving regression lines are excluded' (S2.2) and PMCC formula use excluded (S5.1: 'use of the formula is not required'). Mark scheme requires computing Sxy from the regression slope and then r via formula, which is explicitly excluded; no alternative in-spec method exists here (must use given regression equation).

parts.label: g

parts.reason: Requires calculating E(R) and E(X), both means of discrete random variables, explicitly excluded by S4.1.

parts.label: h
parts.technique: Calculating P(X>Y) via case analysis on distributions of X, R, Y
parts.reason: This is a probability calculation (S3.1/S3.2 style, summing probabilities of joint outcomes) rather than a mean/variance calculation; it uses the given probability distributions of X and R directly rather than depending on the excluded E(X)/E(R) results from (d),(e),(g).
